text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... I have done what was required.
Bring it forth swiftly. The next trial that awaits me.
choice_data_list: (She might be rushing her pace a bit today...!)

text_block_list.text: Orfevre seemed more impatient than usual. Just as I was agonizing over how to point that out to her—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Well done.
Here you go."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Your entire body appears stiffer than usual.
It would be wise to relax your shoulders a bit as you practice.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
Mind your own business.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Now then, if you'll excuse me.
choice_data_list: (...Did they just throw me a lifeline?)

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
It is best to look at it as becoming aware of your own weaknesses.
Please do not blame yourself too harshly.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I understand.
Thank you very much, St. Lite!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Swing my arms like this? Or is this way better?
...Shoot, now I'm totally confused!

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
You need not run perfectly to the letter of my advice.
Simply use that knowledge as nourishment to hone your own stride, my liege.
Even after that... St. Lite was seen all across the course, offering guidance to the students.
choice_data_list: She really cares about her juniors, huh...
She really cares about her juniors...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I'm walking on air.
My throat feels like it's on fire.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...So you have come as well.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, Orfevre.
It is still far too early for you to be drinking alcohol, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Alcohol? No. What I desire is serenity alone.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, was that so? —Then,
would you care to join me? The mocktail is on me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Thy conduct of late...
Art thou not being somewhat overprotective?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I do not dispense charity. —I rule.
A true king expresses supremacy through the tracks left in the turf, do they not?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... That is not incorrect either.
However, children also need 'support'.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
If our backs cannot convey our message, then we must speak it—
That is the duty entrusted to us.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Do you presume to order me?
Claiming it is a king's duty to guide the populace personally?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Of course not.
I am merely making a wish.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: May you be a virtuous guide.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: "Because it must be passed on. The crown, that is. Otherwise, it will simply wait to decay—"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Even the glory you've built.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
(...Pander to the common folk, and you are nothing
more than a foolish king. However... she is right.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Without a next generation, eventually—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, are you serious about closing down the shop?
Isn't there anything we can do?"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: It's just the times, you know. There's no successor, after all.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: So this is how traditions die out and fade away... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am a King. Not a vanguard.
And yet... I am the King. Therefore——

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I will not permit my kingdom to perish.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhhh!!!
choice_data_list: Oh!? A better time than yesterday!
Wha!? That's a better time than yesterday!

text_block_list.text:
Running with absolute composure and overwhelming strength,
Orfevre drew an involuntary gasp of admiration from me.
choice_data_list: Did something get you all fired up?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
I have found the royal decree that must be laid down.
